title: Coral and the Deadline
author: Beatrix Hartwell
blurb: Marguerite Ashgrove, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
